query: PM / product management intern jobs, global

method.discovery: firecrawl_map x4 (search terms: 'product manager intern', 'intern jobs', 'associate product manager intern APM', 'product internship')
method.verification: firecrawl_scrape per job page, formats:['json'], maxAge:0 (forced live fetch)
method.liveness_test: HTTP statusCode. 200 = live, 410 = 'Page no longer available' (delisted)
method.known_gap: Wellfound role/location listing pages (/role/l/..., /role/r/...) return empty on scrape - client-rendered behind auth. Coverage is limited to what map's search index surfaced.
